hostname Leaf-1
!
ip routing
!
ip access-list extended PERIMETER_SECURITY_POLICY

 permit ip any any
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1

 ip access-group PERIMETER_SECURITY_POLICY in
 mtu 1500
 speed 1000
 duplex full
 shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/2
 description Link to Spine-2 eth1
 ip address 10.0.3.2 255.255.255.252
 ip access-group PERIMETER_SECURITY_POLICY in
 mtu 1500
 speed 1000
 duplex full
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/10
 description Host LAN Subnet
 ip address 10.1.10.1 255.255.255.0
 mtu 1500
 no shutdown
!
router bgp 65001
 bgp router-id 10.1.10.1
 bgp log-neighbor-changes
 no bgp default ipv4-unicast
 neighbor 10.0.1.1 remote-as 65000
 neighbor 10.0.1.1 description Spine-1
 neighbor 10.0.3.1 remote-as 65000
 neighbor 10.0.3.1 description Spine-2
 !
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  network 10.1.10.0 mask 255.255.255.0
  maximum-paths 2
  neighbor 10.0.1.1 activate

!
end

hostname Spine-1
!
ip routing
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description Link to Leaf-1 eth1
 ip address 10.0.1.1 255.255.255.252
 mtu 1500
 speed 1000
 duplex full
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/2
 description Link to Leaf-2 eth1
 ip address 10.0.2.1 255.255.255.252
 mtu 1500
 speed 1000
 duplex full
 no shutdown
!
router bgp 65000
 bgp router-id 10.0.1.1
 bgp log-neighbor-changes
 no bgp default ipv4-unicast
 neighbor 10.0.1.2 remote-as 65001
 neighbor 10.0.1.2 description Leaf-1
 neighbor 10.0.2.2 remote-as 65002
 neighbor 10.0.2.2 description Leaf-2
 !
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  neighbor 10.0.1.2 activate
  neighbor 10.0.2.2 activate
 exit-address-family
!
end
